style.name: Ethereal
style.description: Ethereal styling creates a sense of airiness through diffused light, delicate forms, and softly shifting color. The mood is dreamlike and spacious, with clear foreground elements keeping the experience usable.

fonts.heading: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.rationale: Fine serif shapes create a gentle display voice; a solid sans protects clarity in the supporting interface.

tips: Keep text on a stable, readable surface.

avoid: Very pale text on pale backgrounds.
Slow animations that delay access to content.
